items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I had an excellent arranger named Danny Mendelson... he did quite a few of the current pop tunes... some of the sounds of the band was largely responsible to Danny Mendelson.

ctx.x: Right, it was like you -- it had class and dignity.

Now I wouldn't put down that swing thing, because we were not long enough together to develop a good head, because see, you got to have those good head arrangements, that's the best jazz. Now Basie was wise in concentrating on head arrangements instead of making so much emphasis on written. See, I was concentrating on writing for me written arrangements, like Buster Harding and another guy named Danny Mendelson, I was doing a lot of it myself, I borrowed Edgar Sampson, he did quite a bit -- and we were trying to…
